_help: Copy this file to collector_config.json (same folder as collector.py) and fill it in with Notepad. Keys starting with _ are comments. Only the collector reads this file - never the web server. Do not e-mail it or put it in git. Anything written here wins over the same setting on the System page (the page shows it as pinned).

sla._username: The user number you sign in to the portal with.
sla._password: Either write it here, or leave it empty and run: python collector.py --set-password sla  (kept in Windows Credential Manager). The environment variable NBE_SSO_PASSWORD wins over both.

itsm._password: Same idea: write it here, or run: python collector.py --set-password itsm  (the environment variable ITSM_PASS wins over both).

email._target_archive_name: The Outlook archive / root folder to scan, e.g. 2026_Part3. Empty = the default mailbox.

_data_dir: Optional. The shared data folder when this PC should not use the one from config.json, e.g. \\10.104.46.34\calllog\data (backslashes are doubled in JSON). Remove the leading underscore to use it.
